notes: PARTIAL-CONTENT FILE - READ FIRST: this is a genuine SSC CBE exam-screen export for the exact date+shift (header Exam Date 03/08/2023, SSC Question IDs + one candidate's responses throughout), but the source PDF's text layer is only partially recoverable in this environment: the English section Q.1-Q.20 is recovered with stems + most options (Q.1 options 3-4, Q.2 options 1-2, Q.3 options 3-4 and Q.20 options 1-2 are image-only/absent from the parse; Q.15's Question-ID line is missing - it fell on a page boundary; Q.10 options 1 and 2 are identical 'Occasion' in the source (sic); Q.17 option 4 'Hieararchy' sic); the cloze passage (Grim Reaper / Black Death) is fully text-recovered, but for SubQuestions 21-25 only options 3-4 are visible in the parse (options 1-2 image-only); the General Intelligence section Q.1-Q.25 is present in full (all 25 blocks with SSC IDs), with text only for Q.10 (paper-folding stem), Q.11 (triangle-count stem), Q.21 (mirror-image stem), Q.22 (letter-number coding stem + options 2-4, option 1 image-only) and Q.25 (figure-series stem, missing closing bracket sic) - all figures/options otherwise image-only, and in Q.10/Q.11 the option numbers run together in the parse ('1.234' and '1.2021224', sic); the Quantitative Aptitude section has blocks Q.1-Q.17 and Q.21-Q.25, with text for Q.1 (leaked angle option set with embedded key marks), Q.9 (leaked fraction option set), Q.24 (leaked 'cot²tt' fragment + fraction option set) and Q.25 (full trigonometry-identity question); Quant Q.18-Q.20 (global 68-70) blocks are ABSENT from the parsed text layer (no text recovered from the corresponding pages); the General Awareness section has blocks Q.1-Q.19, with text for Q.1-Q.3 (options 2-4 only, option 1 image-only), Q.4 (Jaimal & Patta / fort), Q.5 (ITCZ), Q.6 (FIDE 2022 bronze - 'Koneru Hampi' sic in source) and Q.7 (music director); GA Q.8-Q.19 (global 83-94) image-only; GA Q.20-Q.25 (global 95-100) are ABSENT from the parsed text layer - the document ends at GA Q.19. Everything else is marked [NOT RECOVERABLE] and has NOT been invented, completed or paraphrased. SECTION ORDER on the CBE screen for CHSL 2023 Tier I: 1) English Language (Q.1-25), 2) General Intelligence (Q.1-25), 3) Quantitative Aptitude (Q.1-25), 4) General Awareness (Q.1-25); this file uses global numbering 1-100 in that order (English=1-25, Reasoning=26-50, Quant=51-75, GA=76-100); the original per-section SSC question_id is recorded for every question where present. UNATTRIBUTED FRAGMENTS (listed, NOT attached): (a) Quant - a DI table 'Trains | AC-1st class capacity-200 | AC-sleeper capacity-200 | AC-chair car capacity-400 | First class capacity-300 | 2nd class capacity-500; A: 186 201 313 282 487; B: 190 183 348 215 414; C: 198 191 364 291 484' (position: text gap between the Quant Q.13 (global 63) and Q.14 (global 64) blocks, together with (b)); (b) Quant - an option set of four 'a³+b³+c³−3abc' variants: a³+b³−c³−3abc (X mark), a³−b³+c³−3abc (× mark), a³+b³+c³−3abc (x mark), a³+b³+c³+3abc (X mark) - all four options carry X/× marks (rendering artifact); same gap as (a); (c) Quant - an algebra question fragment: garbled stem equations '1ffff³=270+y³' (sic), 'x=(6+y)', '(x+y)≥', 'x>0', 'y>0]' with option set √3, 4√3, 4√2 (a fourth option garbled/absent) (position: gap between the Quant Q.24 (global 74) and Q.25 (global 75) blocks, after the Q.24 leaked fraction options; the fragment carries no Question-ID block of its own); (d) Quant - a linear-equations fragment '11aa+3b=14' (sic, probably 'a+3b=14') and '2a−3b=10' (same gap as (c)); (e) Quant - a garbled trig option '(up-up-)up==√3/2' (sic) and a DI table 'StatesYears | Assam A/P | Bihar A/P | Kerala A/P | Uttar Pradesh A/P; 2019: 2500 1400 / 4200 3200 / 2800 2200 / 4500 3600; 2020: 2700 1500 / 4500 3400 / 3000 2400 / 4600 3700; 2021: 2900 1800 / 4700 3800 / 3400 2500 / 4800 3800; 2022: 3000 1900 / 5000 3900 / 3500 2600 / 5200 4100' (position: gap between the Quant Q.17 (global 67) and Q.21 (global 71) blocks, spanning the absent Q.18-Q.20 pages; not attached because the owning question cannot be established). LEAKED-FRAGMENT ATTRIBUTION CONVENTION: text-layer fragments that appear directly after a question's own Question-ID + Status block are attributed (as 'probable') to that question, because the following question in every such case carries its own complete ID + Status block; this is a layout inference, flagged per-question. CANDIDATE RESPONSES: recorded per question in answer_note as reference only; they are NOT official answers. KEY-MARK ARTIFACTS: Quant Q.1 (global 51) shows embedded X key marks next to options 1 and 4 and a check-mark-like glyph next to option 2; unattributed fragment (b) shows X/× marks on all four options. These are Adda247's answer-key notation inside the export; they are UNVERIFIED against the SSC official key, so they are recorded in answer_note/notes only and never used to set correct_answer. VERBATIM SOURCE ARTIFACTS (preserved as-is, sic): English Q.10 options 1 and 2 both 'Occasion'; English Q.17 option 4 'Hieararchy'; GI Q.22 (global 47) option 2 'UO14' (no space); GI Q.25 (global 50) stem missing its closing bracket; GA Q.6 (global 81) option 3 'Koneru Hampi'; Quant Q.25 (global 75) source renderings contain spacing artifacts inside the radicals/fractions (normalised to standard notation in this file, values unchanged). ANSWERS: the official CHSL 2023 answer key (final key published 19-Aug-2023 per SSC notice) is downloadable only by logged-in candidates on ssc.gov.in/ssc.nic.in with roll number + password; no machine-accessible official key was found in this environment, so every correct_answer here is null and answer_source null.
